verdict.rationale: Wise Business documents local account details in 40+ currencies for receiving payments (wise-docs-3, wise-docs-9, wise-docs-12, wise-docs-25), a core advertised feature. However, hands-on community reports describe local account numbers (e.g., USD) being changed or invalidated with zero notice, disrupting business payments, and one business being fully blocked from using account details due to a profile-category mismatch — concrete evidence the feature doesn't always work reliably as claimed. Missing for 10: independent verification that account detail changes are rare/well-communicated, and resolution of the blocking case.
